Subject: Request: Academic + nonprofit pilot credits for community health NLP project

Hi Marissa,

I'm Elena Garcia, an associate professor at UC State. Our lab is partnering with the Helping Hands Foundation on a 6-month pilot to build an NLP model to extract social-determinants signals from intake forms. The pilot is grant-funded and Helping Hands will coordinate community outreach.

We signed up through the self-serve flow last week (trial account: egarcia_ucstate) and hit the token limits during initial ingestion. Before we scale, we wanted to request academic/nonprofit credits to cover the pilot (estimated 500k tokens for model eval + embeddings).

Attached: a short project summary and budget outline. We can provide a formal letter confirming grant funding and a W-9 for the nonprofit if needed. Our timeline is Nov 15 start, initial results by Jan 2026.

Can Redwood provide a one-time trial credit allotment or academic promo code? If there's an approval form, happy to complete it.

Thanks for considering — we love the latency on Redwood and hope to move to Dedicated when the pilot proves out.

Best,

Elena Garcia
Associate Professor, UC State
egarcia@ucstate.edu
+1 (415) 555-2187

Attachments: project-summary-ucstate-helpinghands.pdf, budget-outline.xlsx

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and for trying Redwood. Appreciate the timeline and the attachment.

Short answer: yes, we have an academic/nonprofit credits pathway for grants & pilots. To help us expedite, could you upload the grant confirmation or a letter from Helping Hands and the nonprofit W-9? We usually require:

- Grant confirmation or partner statement (PDF)
- Nonprofit W-9 or tax form
- Approx token estimate (you already gave 500k, which is helpful)

If you'd like a quicker route, here's a short self-serve academic request form (one page): https://redwood.example/academic-request — filling it will auto-populate the approval ticket. If you prefer, I can also submit on your behalf once you send the W-9 and grant doc.

Proposed next steps:
- You: upload the W-9 and short grant confirmation to this thread or the form
- Me: route to internal approvals and reserve an initial 750k trial credit allotment pending finance sign-off

I'll loop in Monica from Operations to confirm the standard promo code process and any legal flags.

—Marissa
